narrative: Theo, 26, is a graduate student and teaching assistant with generalized anxiety disorder, diagnosed 3 years ago.
Also a history of disordered eating — a binge-eating pattern from his second year of college, partially resolved through CBT but with a residual night-eating habit.
Takes mirtazapine 15 mg at bedtime for anxiety and sleep — a medication known to stimulate appetite in the hours after dosing, sitting directly on top of his existing night-eating pattern.
The only one of these profiles carrying a mental-health-sensitive history, by design.
